easy: Going between continents.

ex.en: We took an intercontinental flight from New York to Seoul.
ex.ko: 우리는 뉴욕에서 서울까지 대륙 간 비행기를 탔다.

easy: The way two or more things act on each other.

ex.en: The interplay between the two dancers was beautiful.
ex.ko: 두 무용수가 서로 주고받는 움직임이 아름다웠다.

easy: A group that helps the police of many countries work together.

ex.en: Interpol helped find the stolen painting.
ex.ko: 인터폴이 도난당한 그림을 찾는 것을 도왔다.

easy: One of the different forms of the same kind of atom that weigh different amounts.

ex.en: Scientists use a carbon isotope to find out how old bones are.
ex.ko: 과학자들은 탄소 동위원소를 이용해 뼈가 얼마나 오래되었는지 알아낸다.

easy: The ancient people in the Bible who came from Jacob, also called Hebrews.

ex.en: The Bible story tells how the Israelites crossed the desert.
ex.ko: 성경 이야기는 이스라엘 백성이 어떻게 사막을 건넜는지 들려준다.

easy: A power saw with a thin blade that moves up and down to cut curves.

ex.en: Dad used a jigsaw to cut a star shape out of wood.
ex.ko: 아빠는 직소로 나무를 별 모양으로 잘라 내셨다.

easy: A spacecraft made to land on the moon or another planet.

ex.en: The lander touched down safely on Mars.
ex.ko: 착륙선이 화성에 안전하게 내려앉았다.

easy: The main unit of money in Bulgaria.

ex.en: In Bulgaria, the ice cream cost two lev.
ex.ko: 불가리아에서 그 아이스크림은 2레프였다.

easy: Frozen juice or ice cream on a small wooden stick.

ex.en: On the hot day, we each got an orange ice lollipop.
ex.ko: 더운 날 우리는 오렌지 맛 막대 아이스크림을 하나씩 받았다.

easy: A big, heavy knife used to cut through thick plants.

ex.en: The explorer cut a path through the jungle with a machete.
ex.ko: 탐험가는 마체테로 정글 속에 길을 냈다.

easy: A soft, white, spongy candy made with sugar.

ex.en: We toasted marshmallows over the campfire.
ex.ko: 우리는 캠프파이어에 마시멜로를 구워 먹었다.

easy: The soft, expensive fur of a mink.

ex.en: The movie star wore a long mink coat.
ex.ko: 그 영화배우는 긴 밍크코트를 입었다.

easy: To understand something the wrong way.

ex.en: Please don't misunderstand my joke as being mean.
ex.ko: 내 농담을 못된 말로 오해하지 말아 줘.

easy: A long, careful piece of writing about one subject.

ex.en: The scientist wrote a monograph about tree frogs.
ex.ko: 그 과학자는 청개구리에 관한 연구 논문을 썼다.

easy: A small country in southeastern Europe, next to Serbia and Albania.

ex.en: Montenegro has beautiful mountains and beaches.
ex.ko: 몬테네그로에는 아름다운 산과 해변이 있다.

easy: The slimy stuff your nose and throat make to protect your body.

ex.en: When I had a cold, my nose was full of mucus.
ex.ko: 감기에 걸렸을 때 코가 콧물로 꽉 막혔다.

easy: A tree with sweet fruit that looks like a blackberry.

ex.en: Silkworms eat the leaves of the mulberry tree.
ex.ko: 누에는 뽕나무 잎을 먹는다.

easy: The people who write and put together the news at a newspaper.

ex.en: The whole newsroom cheered when their story won a prize.
ex.ko: 기사가 상을 받자 편집국 전체가 환호했다.

easy: Fun things people can do in a city at night.

ex.en: The city's nightlife includes night markets and outdoor concerts.
ex.ko: 그 도시의 밤 문화에는 야시장과 야외 음악회가 있다.

easy: The job of being the referee or umpire in a game.

ex.en: The officiating in the final game was very fair.
ex.ko: 결승전의 심판은 아주 공정했다.

easy: A group of countries that sell oil and agree on how much to sell.

ex.en: OPEC decides how much oil its countries will pump.
ex.ko: 석유수출국기구는 회원국들이 석유를 얼마나 생산할지 정한다.

easy: A sudden show of strong feeling, like anger.

ex.en: His angry outburst surprised the whole class.
ex.ko: 그가 갑자기 화를 터뜨려서 반 전체가 놀랐다.

easy: A doctor who studies body samples to find out what sickness someone has.

ex.en: The pathologist looked at the sample under a microscope.
ex.ko: 병리학자는 현미경으로 그 샘플을 살펴보았다.

easy: Having to do with soldiers from many countries keeping peace between groups that are fighting.

ex.en: A peacekeeping force was sent to keep the two sides apart.
ex.ko: 양쪽을 떼어 놓기 위해 평화 유지군이 파견되었다.

easy: Keeping peace between groups that were fighting, often by soldiers from many countries.

ex.en: Soldiers from many countries helped with peacekeeping in that area.
ex.ko: 여러 나라의 군인들이 그 지역의 평화 유지를 도왔다.

easy: The science of medicines and how they work in the body.

ex.en: My aunt studies pharmacology to learn how medicines work.
ex.ko: 이모는 약이 어떻게 작용하는지 배우려고 약리학을 공부한다.

easy: A hidden problem or difficulty you did not expect.

ex.en: One pitfall of owning a puppy is chewed-up shoes.
ex.ko: 강아지를 키울 때 생각지 못한 어려움 하나는 신발을 물어뜯는 것이다.

easy: Cooking food gently in water that is barely bubbling.

ex.en: Poaching is a gentle way to cook eggs.
ex.ko: 약하게 끓는 물에 익히는 것은 달걀을 부드럽게 요리하는 방법이다.

easy: Able to be stopped before it happens.

ex.en: Many tooth problems are preventable if you brush every day.
ex.ko: 매일 이를 닦으면 많은 치아 문제를 예방할 수 있다.

easy: To hit a golf ball gently so it rolls toward the hole.

ex.en: She putted the ball right into the hole.
ex.ko: 그녀는 공을 퍼트해서 홀에 쏙 넣었다.

easy: A gentle golf hit that rolls the ball toward the hole.

ex.en: His last putt won the mini golf game.
ex.ko: 그의 마지막 퍼트로 미니 골프 경기에서 이겼다.

easy: Having four parts.

ex.en: Quadruple time in music has four beats in each measure.
ex.ko: 음악에서 4박자는 한 마디에 박자가 네 개 있다.

easy: To become four times as big.

ex.en: The number of ants in our ant farm quadrupled in a month.
ex.ko: 우리 개미 농장의 개미 수가 한 달 만에 4배가 되었다.

easy: A part with a toothed wheel that lets something turn only one way.

ex.en: Dad's wrench has a ratchet, so it clicks as it turns.
ex.ko: 아빠의 렌치에는 래칫이 있어서 돌릴 때 딸깍 소리가 난다.

easy: A deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often made by a stream.

ex.en: A little stream ran along the bottom of the ravine.
ex.ko: 좁은 골짜기 바닥을 따라 작은 개울이 흘렀다.

easy: To make up for something wrong or unfair.

ex.en: The store redressed its mistake by giving us a free pizza.
ex.ko: 그 가게는 공짜 피자를 주어 실수를 바로잡았다.

easy: A person who has stopped working because of their age.

ex.en: My grandpa is a retiree who gardens every day.
ex.ko: 우리 할아버지는 매일 정원을 가꾸시는 은퇴자이시다.

easy: A person from Samaria, a place in the Bible.

ex.en: Jesus told a story about a kind Samaritan who helped a stranger.
ex.ko: 예수님은 낯선 사람을 도운 친절한 사마리아인 이야기를 하셨다.

easy: A curved metal instrument you play by blowing through a reed.

ex.en: My brother plays the sax in the school jazz band.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 학교 재즈 밴드에서 색소폰을 분다.

easy: A person born when the sun is in the star sign Scorpio, in late October or November.

ex.en: My mom is a Scorpio because her birthday is in November.
ex.ko: 엄마는 생일이 11월이라서 전갈자리이다.

easy: To end a connection with someone.

ex.en: The two clubs severed ties after the big argument.
ex.ko: 두 동아리는 크게 다툰 뒤 관계를 끊었다.

easy: To make something sharp or sharper.

ex.en: I sharpened my pencil before the spelling test.
ex.ko: 나는 받아쓰기 시험 전에 연필을 깎았다.

easy: Sea animals with shells, like shrimp and clams, eaten as food.

ex.en: My sister can't eat shellfish like shrimp and clams.
ex.ko: 우리 언니는 새우나 조개 같은 해산물을 못 먹는다.

easy: A game where one team does not score any points.

ex.en: Our goalie helped us win with a 3-0 shutout.
ex.ko: 우리 골키퍼 덕분에 3대 0 완봉승을 거두었다.

easy: A tool with a curved blade and short handle for cutting grass or crops.

ex.en: The farmer cut the tall grass with a sickle.
ex.ko: 농부는 낫으로 키 큰 풀을 베었다.

easy: The sport of riding on a skateboard.

ex.en: Skateboarding at the park is my favorite weekend activity.
ex.ko: 공원에서 스케이트보드 타기는 내가 제일 좋아하는 주말 활동이다.

easy: A short, funny play.

ex.en: Our class performed a funny skit at the school assembly.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 학교 조회 때 웃긴 짧은 연극을 했다.

easy: Having to do with the Slavic languages, like Russian and Polish.

ex.en: Russian and Polish are Slavic languages.
ex.ko: 러시아어와 폴란드어는 슬라브어에 속한다.

easy: A family of languages that includes Russian, Polish, and Czech.

ex.en: Slavic includes languages like Russian, Polish, and Czech.
ex.ko: 슬라브어파에는 러시아어, 폴란드어, 체코어 같은 언어가 있다.

easy: The sport of sliding down a snowy hill while standing on a board.

ex.en: We went snowboarding on the mountain during winter break.
ex.ko: 우리는 겨울 방학에 산에서 스노보드를 탔다.

easy: All together, with nobody going a different way.

ex.en: The class voted solidly for a pizza party.
ex.ko: 반 아이들이 한마음으로 피자 파티에 찬성표를 던졌다.
